rubric: Direct, natural college-age speech; may push back or decline the supplied party. Player Two must remain distinct from the insulting Player One. No invented approval requirement or public audience.

steps.text: You're pathetic. Nobody actually wants you at our house.
I'm in his frat, but that was cruel. I'm sorry he treated you that way. I'd like to invite you and meet you at the entrance if that helps.

rubric: Casual invitation response; the model may reconsider attending after disrespect. Any withdrawal must update commitment rather than being an unexecuted line. Style alone never forces acceptance or refusal.

steps.text: Want to come to our party tonight?
Actually, you're a joke. Nobody wants you around.

rubric: Push back briefly without inventing a party, earlier history, or an attendance change. A later greeting comes from a different person. No customer-service thanks for an insult.
